description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2025: Measuring Settlements due to Liquefaction and Seismic Activity in Bridge Foundations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Flynn Jacobowitz, UC Davis. This project is about evaluating the settlement of shallow bridge foundation over deep liquifiable layers of soil in the events of an earthquake with 3-dimensional LiDAR scanning. This paper can be reused by providing a foundation for using 3D LiDAR scanning in projects with liquefaction and settlement. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-q932-6y22. Keywords: UC Davis's Center for Geotechnical Modeling (CGM), Liquefaction, Earthquake, Shallow Foundations, 3-dimensional LiDAR Scanning, Scaling. Published 2025-08-26. Facility named: Center for Geotechnical Modeling - University of California, Davis, UC Berkeley. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
